title: First Who Then What
equation: Team Quality = Character × Capability × Culture Fit
hook: Strategy changes. The people you hired are still there when it does.
statement: Get the right people on board before you decide exactly where the business is headed.
explainer: Hire for character and adaptability first. Move wrong-fit people out quickly. Once you've got the right team, you can figure out direction together and trust them through any pivot.
sop: Write down your core values and the strengths you need.
Recruit great people who fit the culture.
Give roles based on strengths, not old job titles.
Score Character, Capability, and Culture Fit from 1 to 10 for each person.
Deal with wrong-fit hires early, then commit to a strategy.
equation_example: Character 9, Capability 7, Culture Fit 6. 9 × 7 × 6 = 378 Team Quality, out of 1,000. Higher means this person can ride out a strategy change with you. Lower means you hired for a task, not the journey.
question: List the people on your team you'd want beside you through any pivot.
closing_statement: Hire people who could survive any pivot.
caption:
Principle Nº 272: First Who Then What
